positions.title: Project Manager, Ethical AI & Digital Transformation (GAEIA Initiative)
positions.description:
As part of GAEIA (Global Alliance for Ethical and Impactful AI), a joint initiative between Stanford University’s Center for Human Rights and International Justice, UNHCR, and Copenhagen FinTech, I support the development of ethical frameworks for the responsible use of AI and advanced technologies in refugee contexts. This interdisciplinary project bridges academic expertise with industry insights to address the societal and ethical challenges of digital transformation.

My work includes project management, research coordination, and stakeholder engagement, ensuring alignment between research objectives and UNHCR's needs. I contribute to research on AI ethics and policy, organize workshops and collaborative sessions & manage project timelines.
